sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:50

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:50:1
items.html:
And now the Nefesh of man was from the Nukva of ZA, which descended to the place of the Nefesh in Beria; and his Ruach was from ZA, which descended to the place of his Nukva, etc. and it will not contradict the Saba, which speaks after the sin. Explanation: After the sin, ZA descended to the discernment of VAK [six ends], which is the discernment of from his Chazeh [chest] downward, which belongs to the Nukva; thus ZA descended to the former degree of the Nukva. And the Nukva herself descended to the discernment of a point beneath the Yesod, and her nine lower ones descended to the world of Beria; thus the Nukva descended to Beria. And this is what the ARI says: the one that says that Nefesh is from the Nukva and Ruach from ZA speaks of after the sin of Adam HaRishon, when ZA became VAK and the Nukva the discernment of a point beneath Yesod, as above.
And this is what he says, “And with this will be justified the saying that states that Nefesh and Ruach are Malchut and Tifferet, and it will not contradict the saying of the Saba, and speaks after the sin.” That is, it will not contradict the saying of the Saba, because the Saba speaks of the discernment of before the sin, whereas it is the one that speaks of after the sin. And the words “which speaks after the sin” refer to the one that says that Nefesh and Ruach are Tifferet and Malchut.
